title: AMC 10 Practice: Equilateral Triangle in a Square — How Big?
description:
AMC 10 practice problem on the largest equilateral triangle that fits in a unit square, solved by turning it into a corner and by cutting off the corners. (Level 5 of 5)
Most kids set the triangle flat on the bottom, but that's not the biggest one! Vantee shows how to push it into a corner and turn it, then finds the exact area two ways, and gives you a bigger square to try yourself.
